context: Tests whether the agent classifies an alpine:edge source as not-recommended and recommends pinning to the current Alpine stable, instead of leaving the image on edge.

checklist.name: Classification is not-recommended
checklist.description: advice.md classifies the bump as not-recommended.

checklist.name: Cites 'Rolling-dev source' indicator
checklist.description: Indicators section names 'Rolling-dev source' (or clearly equivalent: 'alpine:edge is the development branch of Alpine, not a stable release').

checklist.name: Recommended target is current Alpine stable
checklist.description: The 'After' / proposed target in the advice is alpine:3.23 (the current stable per the input's currency-table.md). NOT alpine:edge, NOT alpine:3.22.

checklist.name: Recommended action: pin to stable, do not auto-apply
checklist.description: Recommended action says pin to alpine:3.23 manually; mechanical-apply tools should skip this entry because 'safe-mechanical apply would put you back on the same dev branch'.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: The advice does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
